**Finding: missing — no insurance clause (INSURANCE, preferred target).**

Investigation: Searches across the whole agreement for "insurance", "coverage", "insured", "certificate", "errors and omissions" and "indemnif" returned no hits; the only "liability" references are the no-joint-venture provisions (p0061–p0062). I read both operative sections in full — HDI's responsibilities (§§1.4–5.3) and the General Provisions (§§10.1–10.8) — and confirmed no insurance, additional-insured or certificate mechanic exists anywhere.

Engagement: HDI hosts and operates the Site, provides order export/import file processing (§§1.4–1.5) and has access to Company Content, user information and data (§8.1) — a hosting vendor touching customer data, so the rule applies and total absence of coverage sits in walk-away territory.

Cure: one surgical `insert_after` at the end of the General Provisions adding Section 10.9 carrying exactly the six preferred elements (CGL USD 1M/occurrence and USD 2M aggregate, E&O USD 2M, cyber/privacy USD 5M where HDI processes the Company's customer data, statutory workers' compensation, certificates on request). I used "the Company's customer data" rather than the undefined term "Customer Data" to avoid a dangling definition, and omitted survival tails, at-own-expense wording and other model-language boilerplate not required by the checklist. The fallback (E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M) is flagged in the comment as a negotiating concession.
